# @zanderio/core (browser half)

The chat cards, artifacts and chat logic the widget imports as
`@zanderio/core/{chat,chat-ui,ui,artifacts}`, copied from Zanderio's internal
core package at commit `b7db7829adcd28a6879869a0f024ca9185d833d2`. `src/` is the TypeScript source and
`dist/` is its `tsc` output, which the widget build bundles. Regenerated by
the widget's release script; don't edit by hand.
